_comment: Outfit id -> JP implementation date, for umas/outfits the Global client's master.mdb has staged (English text present via text_data cat 5/6/47) but that this fork's umalator-global/umas.json doesn't have yet. Global has been replaying JP's implementation order with no reordering (verified against umalator-global/umas.json's own commit history), so this table doubles as the Global rollout order. Not derivable from any local data -- chara_data.start_date in master.mdb is a 2524608000 (2050-01-01) sentinel for everything unreleased -- so it's hand-maintained, transcribed from https://yamasari.blog/umamusume-chara-jissou/ (JP implementation-date tracker). Extend this table (don't guess) the next time this needs to grow past 2023-07-31.
